title: Discipleship
definition: Discipleship is the lifelong process of following Jesus, learning His Word, obeying His commands, and helping others do the same.
summary: Discipleship is following Christ and being formed by His truth, grace, and mission.
christFocus: Jesus calls people to follow Him, learn from Him, obey Him, and make disciples in His name.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Discipleship is not a program only; it is the life of following Jesus. A disciple learns from Christ, submits to His Word, depends on His grace, grows in obedience, and joins His mission.

Discipleship includes both personal growth and helping others grow. Jesus commands His followers to make disciples, teaching them to observe all He commanded.

True discipleship is not rushed. It involves Scripture, prayer, repentance, fellowship, endurance, service, and ongoing transformation into the likeness of Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers remain spiritually immature because they view Christianity as attendance or information instead of a life of following Christ. Discipleship matters because Jesus calls people not only to believe facts, but to follow Him.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Choose intentional growth. Learn Scripture, practice obedience, seek mature fellowship, serve others, and help someone else take a faithful step toward Christ.
